script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let ability be the id of the move labelled "crush" on arg.
Arg uses ability with its cast time and then [{abilityTag: "crush"}, {abilityTag: "crush_recover", abilityOptions: call game:ai.AiUtil.makeAbilityOptionsForSubEffect}].

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let ability be a weighted random move of executer.
If ability is the id of the move labelled "crush" on executer, then
  Let data3 be {abilityTag: "crush_recover"}.
  If call game:ai.AiUtil.isThereEnableAbilityTarget with (executer, data3), then call helper with (executer).
  Otherwise, executer uses the move labelled "crush".
Otherwise, executer uses ability.
